summary: Route subagent child conversations to their parent session's owning host

replay.detail: No stored content or claims change; child links are derived from native transcripts.

schema.detail: No schema or generated client contract changes.

rules.detail: Claim rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Child ids now encode native parent, task, and root routing session. Gateways and owners must all run this encoding; old two-field child links are rejected. Reopen the parent conversation to regenerate links. Managed child reads validate the native parent against the owner's bound transcript.

downtime.detail: No daemon downtime is required beyond the normal upgrade.

manual.detail: Upgrade all gateways and owners together before relying on remote child links; mixed versions are unsupported.

recovery.detail: No persisted child-session inventory or claim data needs recovery. Reopen parent conversations to regenerate volatile child links after an upgrade or rollback.
